findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_invoice, get_invoice · Private data: create_invoice, get_invoice, verify_email_code · Public sink: create_invoice, verify_email_code · Destructive: create_invoice, list_supported_jurisdictions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_invoice, get_invoice · Private data: create_invoice, get_invoice, verify_email_code · Public sink: create_invoice, verify_email_code · Destructive: create_invoice, list_supported_jurisdictions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
